business_problem: Techsun needed to remove concurrency bottlenecks, unify fragmented customer-interaction data, and simplify operations so its AI marketing platform could scale across geographies and global retail brands.
solution_summary: Techsun and Huawei Cloud turned the Socialhub.AI marketing platform into a cloud-native AI CRM, marketing-automation, and customer-data-platform stack for multinational retail and brand customers. GaussDB for MySQL acts as the system of record, DMS for Kafka ingests and moves interaction data in real time, and DCS for Redis accelerates hot reads and reduces database pressure. Cloud Container Engine CCE containerizes the application for high availability and elastic expansion, while ETL pipelines add governance and security controls before data is used for analytics and automated marketing decisions. This platform lets Techsun consolidate distributed customer-interaction data, run AI-native segmentation and decisioning, and deploy into multiple regions on a single architecture rather than disconnected regional stacks. Combined with Huawei Cloud's automation tooling, the design improves system responsiveness, stability, and launch speed for new services.

solution_components.name: Socialhub.AI

solution_components.role: Stores the core operational data used by the marketing platform.

solution_components.name: DMS for Kafka
solution_components.role: Collects and streams interaction data in real time for downstream processing and decisioning.

solution_components.name: DCS for Redis
solution_components.role: Caches hot data to speed response times and reduce load on the primary database.

solution_components.name: Cloud Container Engine CCE
solution_components.role: Provides high-availability container orchestration and elastic scaling for the SaaS platform.

data_flow: Interaction data from distributed customer systems is streamed through DMS for Kafka, persisted in GaussDB for MySQL, and accelerated through Redis caching. ETL and governance processes prepare the data for analytics and AI marketing decisions, which are then served through Socialhub.AI on CCE across regional deployments.
integration_points: global brand and retail customer systems
business_outcome: Techsun improved platform responsiveness, data throughput, operational efficiency, and launch speed, giving its AI marketing stack a more scalable base for global expansion.
metrics: data flow and processing efficiency improved 300%

The data plane combines a relational system of record, real-time event streaming, and Redis caching.
CCE handles the containerized SaaS deployment and elastic scaling layer.
ETL governance and security controls are part of the production data pipeline.
